# Support

Where to ask, response targets, supported versions and support options for teams are on the support page: https://twd.dev/support

- Bugs and feature requests: [open an issue](https://github.com/BRIKEV/twd/issues/new/choose)
- Questions: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BRIKEV/twd/discussions)
- Security vulnerabilities: see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never a public issue.
